name: XDS / X-LAB 喜德盛 GT600
why_interesting: A mid-budget domestic gravel platform backed by unusually strong manufacturing and support evidence.

source_note: An exact GT600 retailer post documents a carbon frame, fork and seatpost build at 11.5 kg with SRAM Apex 1×11, Apex HRD brakes and fitted 700×40C tires. The fitted tire does not establish maximum clearance. The older ¥6,840–7,600 reference range remains because exact generation and trim mapping are unresolved.
